runtimes.value: mflux (Turbo only: Boogu/Boogu-Image-0.1-Turbo, 'mflux-generate-boogu'); ComfyUI native since June 2026 (docs tutorial; on an M1 Max the fp8 build fails on MPS, bf16 works, ~70 s per Turbo image); stable-diffusion.cpp (Base, Turbo and Edit, Metal; uses Comfy-Org files and a Qwen3-VL GGUF text encoder); DiffSynth-Studio (T2I and edit; README says replace 'cuda' with 'mps'); diffusers custom pipeline from the card (BooguImageTurboPipeline, comment 'switch to mps'). Official repo assumes CUDA and flash-attn
runtimes.note: The M1 Max report is a single blog post. mflux does not cover Base, Edit or Edit-Turbo. The card says Draw Things can import it; Draw Things release notes do not mention Boogu, so unverified. diffusers and DiffSynth on MPS untested by any report found.

web.scope: Searched on 13.11.2026: Hacker News comments only (Algolia API). Reddit, Hugging Face discussions and runtime issues not read yet.
web.summary: Divided opinions. One of the few recent Apache 2.0 image models; worth a side-by-side test against Qwen-Image-2512 and Qwen-Image-Edit-2511.
web.verdict: Divided: the Edit variant judged much better than Qwen-Edit by one user, very poor by another

comments.text: Judged very poor: not better than its contemporaries in any respect ([SV_BubbleTime, 20.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49781048)).
Edit variant: judged very good, clearly better than Flux.2 Klein 9B and Qwen-Edit ([woadwarrior01, 22.06.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48634277)).

Scored 6/15 on the GenAI Showdown text-to-image benchmark, against 4/15 for Qwen-Image 1.0/2512, with good coherence ([vunderba, 20.09.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49776784)); later called underrated and quite decent ([vunderba, 17.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50127184)).
